name: LiftIron
tagline: Chat-based strength coach that picks your next load, reps and deload week
description: A lifting coach that works in chat. Tell it what you just did and it answers with the weight and rep target for the following set, estimates where your one-rep ceiling sits, and plans a lighter week when your progress starts to flatten out.
author: realMAG1775
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
